name: print-social-crimson-hiring-post-with-man-at-laptop-and-yellow-labels
title: Crimson 'We're Hiring!' post with a man at a laptop and yellow label boxes
whatItIs: A square crimson post with a yellow 'Hiring!' headline and a yellow tagline box, a cut-out grey-haired man with a sweater over his shoulders working at a laptop with coffee, a yellow 'Open Positions' speech tab over roles with left-rule chevrons, CV and WhatsApp details and a yellow handle bar.
whatItMeans: Warm and inclusive; an experienced professional signals the team values all ages.
techniques: Show a real person working rather than a prop.
Use yellow label boxes against crimson.
Mark roles with a left rule and chevron.

vocabulary.definition: A vertical line on the left of an item.
A solid box behind short text.
